image_description: A stocky, dark-furred wombat is curled up in a resting position within a rocky enclosure or burrow entrance. The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body with coarse brownish-grey fur. Its head is broad and blunt, tucked slightly downwards. Short, powerful limbs are visible, supporting its low-slung posture. The background consists of textured rock formations and earth.
